items.title: Longest Route
items.text: The first player to have 5 continuous roads in play receives this tile. If another player has more continuous roads in play, they immediately receive this tile. The Longest Route tile is worth 2 VPs.

items.title: Largest Army
items.text: The first player to have 3 Knight cards in play receives this tile. If another player has more Knight cards in play, they immediately receive this tile. The Largest Army tile is worth 2 VPs.

items.title: Monopoly
items.text: When you play this card, announce one type of resource. Each player must give you all their resource cards of that type. You may only request one type of resource when you play this card, regardless of how many cards you receive.

extraction_notes: The only file is the rulebook catan-rules.pdf. It has no punch-out component sheets, so no items were cut out of the files.
Page 3 pictures the components with their printed counts. Each printed group is recorded in rules_items with source page 3 and from_rules true, so no item is cut from a picture.

Printed counts on page 3 total 270 items: 6 sea frame pieces, 19 terrain hexes, 2 bonus VP tiles, 4 player aids, 18 number discs, 25 development cards, 95 resource cards, 2 card trays, 2 dice, 1 robber, 20 settlements, 16 cities, 60 roads.
Card backs (development and resource) are not counted as items.
Page 1 (cover) is excluded. Page 12 credits and copyright are recorded in game.credits and excluded from rules.txt.
The expansion advert band at the bottom of page 2 is printed on a rules page, so its text is kept in the rules.
Each of 0 unique designs (pixel-identical fronts grouped) was read by independent single-component model calls until every value had a majority; 0 designs were unanimous, 0 were resolved by hand.
